description: This file defines the createDuration function for constructing duration objects from various input formats, including ISO and ASP.NET date formats, and includes utility functions for parsing and calculating differences between moments.

classes.name: Duration
classes.description: Class representing a duration of time, instantiated within createDuration.

methods.name: createDuration
methods.description: Constructs a Duration object from various input formats, including duration objects, numbers, and date strings.

methods.name: parseIso
methods.description: Parses ISO 8601 duration components, applying sign.

methods.name: positiveMomentsDifference
methods.description: Calculates the difference in milliseconds and months between two moments, assuming the first is before the second.

methods.name: momentsDifference
methods.description: Calculates the difference between two moments, considering their validity and offset.
